title: Measurability of the Radon–Nikodym density
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$, and consider the real-valued Radon–Nikodym density $x \mapsto \left(	frac{d\mu}{d
u}(x)ight)$, obtained from the $[0,\infty]$-valued Radon–Nikodym derivative $	frac{d\mu}{d
u}\colon \Omega 	o [0,\infty]$ by taking its real value at each point. Then this function $\Omega 	o  br$ is measurable.
